title: Encrypte your code against haters
author: Technical_Ticket1828
selftext:
Dump account for obvious reasons 

So, I have a steam game I used ai for coding and not disclose, he was posted 6 months ago and makes me a pretty good money since a streamer picked it up, yes this streamer probably wouldn't pick up the game if he was ai disclosed

Now, apparently I had console log Claude ticket xyz

Now someone decrypted my code a month ago no idea why, and literally blackmail me.

Conclusion hide the console output,or just disclose ,remember comments do not appear in decompile.

Will probably pay it only 100 usd, FML

comments.author: count023
comments.body: errr, yea, there's no such thing as blackmail here, tell him to go fuck himself, and steam does not require you to disclose AI's use for coding so there's nothing to blackmail you with.

replies.author: Technical_Ticket1828
replies.body:
Really?

Thanks 🙏 

I was so freaked out

replies.author: Bioleague
replies.body:
Uhm, where did this lie start from? Steam absolutely does require you to disclose AI use for code. He also mentioned that he generated Icons for the game.

https://preview.redd.it/3s1ampmsluuh1.png?width=715&format=png&auto=webp&s=e95016697e775be75e0de46ee055b1efb064758b

It will come out at some point, and the next guy won't blackmail you, he will report it. It's fraud and they will disable and ban your developer account from steam, along with other potential legal action. I would contact steam yourself ASAP - and explain that you misunderstood the survey, and would like to disclose AI usage.

replies.author: Technical_Ticket1828
replies.body:
Really?

So all the triple AAA companies do not use AI?

replies.author: Bioleague
replies.body:
They do, and they disclose it. Imagine the lawsuits that would take place if a AAA studio committed fraud like that

https://preview.redd.it/wzy63piwxuuh1.png?width=801&format=png&auto=webp&s=65968e435b4bb868988776944dcbf475220c9eee

Here is the AI disclosure for call of duty: black ops 7 for example

comments.author: kookslayer9000
comments.body: If you weren’t using ai for coding or game dev at this point I’d think your crazy. Imagine in 6 months. I understand distaste for the “slop” and low effort content but there’s no way the anti ai sentiment can truly have much of an impact much longer for good products imo.
